intro: Zombie Juice is an errand run on behalf of Abercrombie, the peculiar hermit dwelling in the haunted wilds of Duskwood. Claiming to suffer from the oppressive midnight chill, he dispatches travelers to Darkshire's tavern to secure an unusually potent concoction.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.
And please hurry, friend. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
